variantNote: Traditional Xitsonga month names as printed on South African Xitsonga calendars and in Xitsonga school/Bible usage. Loanword forms (Janyuwari, Fevuyari, Mars, Aprili, Mey, Juni, Julayi, Ogasti, Septemba, Oktobha, Novemba, Disemba) also circulate in everyday speech and media; the traditional set is used here as the standard written calendar. No claim about Shangani/Mozambican variants.
note: Machine draft from memory, not fluent-speaker approval. Confidence moderate to high on the sequence; the middle months (Mudyaxihi May, Khotavuxika June, Mawuwani July, Mhawuri August) are the ones most worth a native check, as is spelling of Nyenyenyani/Nyenyankulu. Short forms are first letters, kept distinct (Nyny vs Nyku).
